purpose: SlimFormer++ is a 3D Slicer scripted module for automatic segmentation of 15 abdominal organs in CT images using a Mamba-free SlimFormer++ architecture and nnU-Net v2 pre- and post-processing pipelines.
summary: The SlimFormerPlusPlus extension is well-structured, follows Slicer conventions, handles dependencies (PyTorch and nnU-Net) properly via existing extension infrastructure, includes comprehensive error checking and cancellation support, and clearly communicates its research-only disclaimer and noncommercial model license. 🟢 Recommend merge

safety.rationale: Inspected all Python code and CMake configuration. No malicious code, unauthorized telemetry, unsafe deserialization, or hardcoded secrets found.

environment.rationale: Inspected SlimFormerPlusPlus.py and requirements checks; uses PyTorchUtils and SlicerNNUNetLib properly without mutating shared environment or packages outside Slicer extension standards.

packaging.rationale: Inspected CMakeLists.txt files in root and module subdirectory; all required python scripts and resources are correctly listed for installation.

license.rationale: Inspected LICENSE.txt, LICENSE-MODEL.txt, and NOTICE.md. Clear distribution terms (Apache 2.0 for module code, research-only license for network/weights).

soundness.rationale: Inspected SlimFormerPlusPlus.py, model.py, predict.py, reorient.py, and blocks.py. Proper error handling, cancellation support, process management, and Slicer conventions observed.

utility.rationale: Inspected module help, acknowledgment text, metadata, tests, and documentation notices. Clear research disclaimers are present.
